title: Global sections on a power-series open with punctured zero section
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], and let $d>0$ be an integer. Put $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and let $z:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ be the morphism induced by constant coefficient [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $V\subset\operatorname{Spec}B$ be open and suppose $z^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$. The canonical ring homomorphism $B=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}B,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ is bijective. No reducedness, integrality, normality or nonempty-cover assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0EY9, pione.tex, lemma-fully-faithful-power-series-over-depth2: first displayed comparison of global section rings in the proof; its injectivity detail is expanded using Tags 00IQ and 0311.

proof.text: For the canonical restriction r, apply the formal-approximation theorem. It assigns every section a unique power series matching all its punctured zero-section infinitesimal germs.

A section whose germs belong to every power of each zero-section stalk-map kernel has zero germs there. Each kernel is proper because the target stalk is a nontrivial ring. The local rings of V are Noetherian by the finite-variable power-series Noetherian instance. Apply Krull intersection, then the punctured zero-section germ-detection theorem, to deduce that the section is zero.

If r(a)=r(b), both a and b formally approximate r(a), since the germ of zero is in every ideal power. Uniqueness of formal approximation implies a=b. Given a section s, choose its formal approximation b; step 2 gives s-r(b)=0, so r(b)=s. These prove injectivity and surjectivity of exactly the canonical map in the statement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EY9, first global-sections comparison. G2 formalized the formal-approximation/associated-germ route; local Krull intersection and the final injectivity/surjectivity assembly are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem bijective_powerSeries_punctured_globalSections
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).inv ≫ V.ι.appTop).hom
